title: Building horror game from Claude AI
author: James_Cyflixel
selftext: I'm making horror game called GUTTER from Claude free version. Can I able to make it? 🫩

comments.author: imlo2
comments.body: You have access to Claude, start asking it and proceed one step at a time?

replies.author: James_Cyflixel
replies.body: For a new chat It can actually make upto phase 2 at once but when chat get longer 5 hour limit comes so fast. But I'm trying to make it. Hope I can. I already created a test game from it

comments.author: Water-Cheese
comments.body: You will struggle to make anything with the free version as it's usage is very limited and you can only use the more basic AI models. I'd recommend a paid version minimum for creating games.

comments.author: HouseOfWyrd
comments.body: Based on this post alone I'm going to say no.

replies.author: James_Cyflixel
replies.body: Why no lol? I will inform when it created so stay updated 🫠

replies.author: HouseOfWyrd
replies.body:
Because game dev is hard, even with the coding handled for you. 

This kind of post doesn't usually come from people who have the suitable amount of follow through.

comments.author: Nostradamivre
comments.body: what's the scoop of your game ?

replies.author: James_Cyflixel
replies.body: A horror game based on Guttur/Swear area. I don't think so Claude can make on free version

replies.author: Nostradamivre
replies.body: So sorry that not what i meant. What’s the scope in terms of gaming? A 1h story-driven game, 5 hours, 10+ hours? 3D, 2D, card game, point and click? Because Claude free has very limited resources for coding. So if you want a 10+ hour story-driven game in 3D, the free version of Claude wouldn’t be a good fit. A simple horror card game, with no story, no levels, etc., is more doable.

replies.author: James_Cyflixel
replies.body: Not a 10hr+ game. It's a 3D game with puzzles to escape like Granny Game.

replies.author: Nostradamivre
replies.body:
My dude... you’re the one asking, so please, please give us details, otherwise you’re not going to get far.  
The Granny series is a 3D game that can take 5+ hours because of the replay value for 100%. It’s a huge project for a solo dev. (depending of the level of skills of the dev)

From what you’ve told us, the answer is likely no, you wouldn’t be able to do this on a free Claude subs.

replies.author: James_Cyflixel
replies.body: not level of skills but I'm trying to test making a game on claude free version. Not too big

replies.author: Nostradamivre
replies.body: so try it, when you hit the wall of free subs is where is your awnser, good luck
